headers.comment: The service worker decides which version of the app a phone runs. If a browser serves a cached copy of THIS file, a rider stays on old code no matter how many times they reload, and there is nothing they can do about it from their end.

The page itself is one big generated file and changes on every deploy. The service worker serves it network-first and falls back to its own cache offline, so revalidating here costs nothing and staleness costs a lot.
The manifest names the app on the home screen; a stale one survives a reinstall.
